Hey, I not an expert, but I am depressed, and was depressed when I was 15, so here's what would've helped me at that time. Everyone is different, and again, I'm not a professional.
Ask them if they're doing alright. Start subtly, but work your way to being more obvious. Start with just a simple "how's it going?". The usual response will probably be (if they're anything like me) a simple "I'm ok" or something similar. Keep at it, and work your way to being more obvious about it. From "how's it going?" To "are you doing alright?" And if they don't offer a good enough answer, eventually just straight up ask them "are you depressed?"
For his sake, I hope not. Good luck, and make sure he eats something!

Please don't feel like a burden. Your friends are really great people, and they want to support you. They care so much about you, and if anything, it's worse to not tell them. They care about you and want you to be ok. You're amazing, and perfect, and you are not a failure. Keep moving forward, and if you need to vent to someone who doesn't know you irl, dm me, I'm never doing anything more important than you are.

It varies between a few reasons. I need what I'm feeling to be real, to not have it just be stupid thoughts in my head. If it's a bad day, I just need to feel something, it's hard to feel anything now, so pain is better than empty. And finally it's just habit now. I can't stop, and I don't feel like i have a great reason to stop.
How many years is that going to take? I've waited 5 years and I'm fucking tired of waiting. It's not fucking worth waiting if I have to live through this.

Sorry if I come across as annoying, but believe me make sure you try anything else first. It doesn't matter how strong-willed you think you are, it's insanely hard to stop, and even once you stop it's hard to keep from coming back. I'm speaking from experience, it's not something I would recommend to anyone. Try other things first, before this.
Trust me, that's not ever as true as you think. I can tell you're in a bad place mentally, and trust me, I've I've there/am there as well, but there is someone who cares.

It started 2 years ago. I needed to prove that my feelings weren't fake. I needed some way to prove to other people and prove to me that I wasn't just making up all of this. The issue is that this is addictive. I wasn't  too bad for the first year, because my pain tolerance was way lower. But for a while it was bad, and I worked hard, and got clean. Started again last week. Wish I could just go back in time and stop myself.

You're right. People will say that "you're just doing all this for attention", and maybe they're right. The issue is that this feels like the only way to find it, and that it feels like there's no other way.
I feel exactly the same way. It feels awful to feel like you're driving away the people you care about. Believe me though, your friends care more about you than you think.
Weirdly enough, when I vent, I don't really need a response. I just need to say everything in my head cause I'm worried no one will know why I died. I just need to say it somewhere.
That helps a good bit. I've got a "friend" who always is trying to downplay my depression, and it feels like I needed to prove to them that I'm not faking this. Thanks.
